prompt: Cinematic long-exposure night photograph of a rain-wet city highway, shot low from behind a single dark car. Streaks of crimson and amber tail-light trails sweep along the road into the distance on the right. The car's two brake lights flare bright red with soft halos reflected on the wet asphalt, and a thin luminous cyan rectangular corner-bracket box frames the pair of brake lights, like a computer-vision detection box. Near-black blue night, deep shadows, subtle rain bokeh. The car is plain: no badges, no logos, blank licence plate. Wide 2:1 composition. The left third of the canvas stays quiet, dark and low-detail so a title can be placed there. No text, letters, numbers, watermarks, borders, people or robots.
